diagnosis: MilestoneViewSet enables BrowsableAPIRenderer with a serializer whose PrimaryKeyRelatedField defines queryset = CorporateProject.objects.all(). When an authenticated client requests HTML (Accept: text/html), the Browsable API renders a form containing an HTML <select> dropdown populated with corporate projects across all competitor organizations.
